description: This file defines the EntitySchemaSubscriber class for listening to entity schema changes within Drupal's workspaces module. It manages adding and removing revision metadata fields related to workspaces on entity types.

classes.name: EntitySchemaSubscriber
classes.description: A class that listens to entity schema changes and manages workspace-related revision metadata fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the subscriber with update manager, schema repository, and workspace info services.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, typically entity type events.

methods.name: onEntityTypeCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of an entity type, adding revision metadata if supported.

methods.name: onFieldableEntityTypeCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a fieldable entity type, delegating to onEntityTypeCreate.

methods.name: onEntityTypeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to an entity type, adding or removing revision metadata based on support.

methods.name: onFieldableEntityTypeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to fieldable entity types, delegating to onEntityTypeUpdate.

methods.name: onEntityTypeDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of an entity type (no action needed).

methods.name: addRevisionMetadataField
methods.description: Adds a 'workspace' revision metadata field to an entity type if not already present.

methods.name: getWorkspaceFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates and returns the base field definition for the 'workspace' entity reference field.
